notes: All 35 canonical armor pieces are explicitly marked as curated Market catalog items in the Armor_Outer category.
Armor migration now writes shopType=arms, curatedCatalogV10=true, catalogEnabled=true, Market category metadata, and canonical Market price metadata.
Armor remains eligible for Street Exchange, Arms Dealer, Black Market, and Specialist Vendor stock according to the existing Market category rules and vendor Mk cap.
Every armor description displays its canonical price alongside AC, Dexterity contribution, weight, availability, and manufacturer signature effect.
The Market uses the same canonical priceCredits value written by the armor catalog, so purchase price and description price stay synchronized.
